purpose: Bounded validation-only diagnosis of exact network spatial/phase symmetry projection; not training or independent test evidence.
d4: Eight square rotations/reflections, signed q invariant under spatial orthogonal transforms.
phase_odd: (q(F)-q(1-F))/2, signed q reverses under phase complement.
data: Exactly existing circle validation 16384 and old enhanced resolved validation abs(q)<=.25; no new data or geometry metadata in network.
guard: Original enhanced7 reference, overall and weak(abs(q)<.001) and plane(q==0) MAE <=1.1*reference+1e-7; full coverage required.
native_target: Existing actual native particles validation q MAE, not HF or flux PLIC.
decision: Retain all three seeds and raw. Candidate advances only if all seeds meet native MAE and guard. No extra variants, training, blind generation or parameter tuning; stop after four-method matrix.
timing: Accuracy only here. If eligible, actual runtime measured by agent02; no multiplication/division of old runtime by view count.
parameters: Exactly source weights unchanged; projections have zero learned parameters.
